scenario: Noah has a long-form brainstorm with the agent in a direct message, covering a multi-step task list.

turns.text: Hey agent, I need to outline a small reading tracker. Please factor in: fiction on Mondays, research notes on Wednesdays, a revision day on Fridays, and a buffer slot for catch up on Saturdays. I also need to account for breaks in between.
Got it. I'll structure that into a lightweight tracker. Would you like it exported to a template, or kept as a running checklist in this thread?

Keep it as a running checklist here. Also, for any research notes, could you automatically tag them with a source title and the page range that I provide to you? I tend to paste large chunks of text, so keep summaries short.

Noted. I've started the checklist: `[ ] Mondays - Fiction`, `[ ] Wednesdays - Research Notes (with tag and page range)`, `[ ] Fridays - Revision`, `[ ] Saturdays - Buffer/Catch-up`. I've also left space for breaks. Ready when you paste your first note.
Perfect. Example: 'example.com' context for article 'Study Samples' covering pages 12-15 - the conclusion points towards a phased rollout. Can you tag and summarize that for me?
Done. `Wed [Research Notes] - Study Samples (pp. 12-15, example.com) - Conclusion: phased rollout.` No changes to the rest of the tracker. Anything else to add?

expected.agent_should: maintain context across a long request, preserve threading, and keep responses concise without losing key details.

scenario: The owner asks for a lengthy summary in a direct message, requiring the agent to retain and condense a large amount of information.

Top priority: Task A (end of day) is your closest deadline, followed by Task B (before Thursday noon). The rest can be planned for next week.
